text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder and I have come to a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Whenever I pray at a shrine, there's something important I like to keep in mind.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. When we pray, it should be for the sake of others. Any benefit to ourselves is only a happy bonus.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The tradition goes that Japanese deities respond best to prayers for the land and its people as a whole.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I've been told it is improper to pray only for yourself.
choice_data_list: That's a nice way of thinking.
That's a nice way of thinking.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's only one point of view, of course, but I believe the deities will take notice if I honor it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: According to an old Japanese saying, compassion for others is always rewarded. I find it to be a wonderful sentiment. ♪
choice_data_list: I'll give it a shot, too.
I'll give it a shot, too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, you will? Then let's go offer our prayers together. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Reflecting carefully on Grass Wonder's words, I pray for the prosperity of all Umamusume in their races.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Whew… All done. The rest depends on the gods' temperament.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: One should always do their best… but sometimes a little divine aid is the push you need. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Considering how committed she is to doing her best, I'm sure the gods will provide their blessings.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Whew… We're all done now, but…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh dear. Perhaps the gods aren't in the best of moods?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us run back to the academy in the pouring rain.
